summary: Unit test spawns a real fake-pi subprocess and verifies exactly one get_state RPC with all isolation flags (--no-session/--no-tools/etc), and a stalling backend genuinely times out to needsAttention within the bound, rejecting extra commands, missing isolation args, and unbounded hangs; UI test's REQ-011.2.1 tag is only tangential (bypasses real RPC via env shortcut) but doesn't undermine the genuine unit coverage.
